$comment: Suite model-card/v1 (v6.3 M2b): the pairings of contracts/semantics/model_pairings.json (O03), parameters shared within one model, observation use within a joint evaluation (R-AUX) and cross-model sharing. Not supported: shapes, multivariate constraints, joint evaluations of several cards (undefined cross-model merges), full HistFactory. Pre-release 1.1.0-dev.5 (release R3): check-context 1.1.0; r-aux.use at 1.1.0 (the R2 rule fixes; see the registry); the other rules are 1.0.0. check-report refuses a pre-release suite.
not_supported: joint evaluations of several model cards (no combiner contract)
